name: retrofit
summary: An annotation-based REST client abstraction for Dart and Flutter that generates Dio-backed API client implementations.
advantages: Keeps REST endpoint definitions declarative and typed
Generated implementation is backed by Dio
tradeoffs: Adds annotations and a generation workflow
Generated clients do not replace API-domain boundaries and error modeling
recommendedFor: Dio-based REST APIs with many typed endpoints
Teams that prefer declarative endpoint interfaces and generated client implementations
